content: API surface and protocol versioning: semver major for any removal, with at least one minor release containing the deprecation notice first. For peer negotiation use the AHP shape: client offers an ordered version list, host picks one and returns it, both use it for the session, capability flags are checked before using newer features, and capabilities are promoted to baseline in a later version. Microsoft api-extractor emits a git-tracked .api.md public API report so every surface change appears in review, detects missing and accidental exports, and supports alpha/beta/public graduation. publint and arethetypeswrong validate the published package. A new major API must not depend on a previous major.
